newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sweet crudes swing to negative differentials.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sweet crudes swing to negative differentials.

text.p: U.S. sweet crude grades returned to negative differentials Wednesday afternoon, deflated by refiner moves ahead of Thursday's April NYMEX contract expiry.
April Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James had gained to a 15 cents premium to the April West Texas Intermediate/Cushing before midday, but quickly slumped back to the even level.
Traders said the latest LLS deals were done at WTI/Cushing -3 cts, steady from Tuesday, but 12 cts off earlier sales.
Outright crude prices recovered to move 20 cts higher for April/WTI at $22.20-30 a barrel.
